name: space-dots-scroll-without-a-scrollbar
description: A sideways scroll over the space dots bar must never draw a scrollbar. The bar keeps overflow-x: auto so a long dot list still scrolls, and hides the bar itself with scrollbar-width: none plus the -webkit-scrollbar rule, the same treatment .scrollzone got for the vertical list. The fixture carries 20 spaces so the dots genuinely outgrow the bar. The graded assertions pin the live page: the bar overflows, the computed scrollbar-width is none, and the gesture really moved scrollLeft, so the absence claim cannot pass on a bar that never scrolled. The scrollbar pixels themselves are checked by reading the scrub burst's frames.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dotscroll'); if (!b) return 'NOBAR'; return b.scrollWidth > b.clientWidth ? 'overflows' : 'flat:' + b.scrollWidth + '/' + b.clientWidth; })()
actions.note: the setup holds: 20 spaces make the dots outgrow the bar, otherwise there is nothing to scroll and nothing to assert

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dotscroll'); if (!b) return 'NOBAR'; return getComputedStyle(b).scrollbarWidth || 'unset'; })()

actions.note: Overview and + sit outside the scroller, so x30 (their slot) no longer reaches it - x110 sits inside .dotscroll itself. A hover scrub here is harmless: nothing below reads the magnify state.
the burst frames are the scrollbar check: before the fix an overlay bar paints along the strip under the dots while the scroll runs

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dotscroll'); if (!b) return 'NOBAR'; return b.scrollLeft > 0 ? 'scrolled' : 'unscrolled'; })()
actions.note: the presence assertion beside the absence one: the wheel really reached the scroller

assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the dot list is wider than the bar, so a scrollbar would have something to indicate
THE RULE: the live page computes scrollbar-width none on the bar
the gesture landed in the scroller - without this, the two assertions above would pass on a bar nobody scrolled
